title: thymus × bractichina
intro: Thymus × bractichina, commonly known as whorly thyme or whorly thymus, is a hybrid plant derived from the Thymus genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in soothing respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Thymus × bractichina include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, helping to open airways and improve breathing. The bioactive constituents present in Thymus × bractichina include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
